steps.content: Upon returning to the camp, you unload the supply boxes on your back, then press the button on your arm to take off the entire suit.
The weather has gradually warmed up, you wipe the sweat off your forehead, and haul the armor and supplies onto the cart.

steps.speaker: Vanilla
steps.content: Just leave them here.
Vanilla pipes up from behind you, her voice as calm as ever. After such a long battle, it's hard not to feel reassured hearing her voice.

options: It's okay, I can handle it.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You already have to build the mech. Let me handle trivial things like this.

steps.speaker: Vanilla
steps.content: You've done a great job today.
Vanilla walks over to you, naturally taking over the cart. She's still limping a bit.

steps.speaker: Vanilla
steps.content: Just rest when you return to the camp. Leave the rest to the logistician.
As she speaks, she pushes the cart to the side of the workbench, then lifts the armor parts onto it.
She fishes out her tools, and repairs the armor in a swift manner. You've watched her do this many times, but you never get bored of it.

options: Where did you learn all this?

steps.speaker: Vanilla
steps.content: At the DisSea Observation Outpost.
Vanilla answers without looking up.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: What is that place?

steps.speaker: Vanilla
steps.content: Just as the name suggests, it's a place that monitors the DisSea and records observation data.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Did the people at the outpost teach you mechanical skills?
Vanilla freezes for a moment.

steps.speaker: Vanilla
steps.content: No. I was the only one at the outpost.

steps.speaker: Vanilla
steps.content: There were many monitoring instruments that needed maintenance, and I learned as I went by fixing them.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Did you need to maintain exoskeleton armor and military mechs at the outpost as well?

steps.speaker: Vanilla
steps.content: No, but it's pretty similar to fixing monitoring instruments. I just need to connect the dots and apply what I've learned.
You might not know much about mechanics, but you do know maintaining monitoring instruments and military machinery are two different areas of expertise.
A self-taught mechanic who gets to this level of skills? It's truly impressive.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: So the expedition team invited you because of your ability to "apply what you've learned"?

steps.speaker: Vanilla
steps.content: Not exactly.

steps.speaker: Vanilla
steps.content: The outpost was originally established to support the scientific expedition teams exploring the Black Ring. When the expedition team passed by, they were short on logisticians, so I joined when they invited me.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: They just wanted to recruit a logistician, and ended up with a mechanical expert.

steps.speaker: Vanilla
steps.content: ...You flatter me. There are others in the team who also dabble in the area, but as scientists, they have more important tasks.

steps.speaker: Vanilla
steps.content: I'm just helping out as much as I can as the team's logistician.
During the small talk, Vanilla has finished repairing the armor. She lifts her head to meet your gaze, her eyes carrying a gentle smile.

steps.speaker: Vanilla
steps.content: By the way, how do you feel about this armor after using it?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: It's great, very handy.

steps.speaker: Vanilla
steps.content: You can drop the formality. I'm well aware that it's a suit built for transportation purposes. It has many limitations.
She glances at the sweat stains on your clothes.

steps.speaker: Vanilla
steps.content: I'm adding a cooling system to the armor. Is there anything else you want?
Hearing her suggestion, you make an attempt to tickle her funny bone.

options: I want a super power source.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Can you help make a pair of sturdy and powerful exoskeletal fists? I'd feel much safer.

steps.speaker: Vanilla
steps.content: Of course, I'm sure it will help a lot.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Maybe a set of speed-boosting prosthetics? I always felt like I wasn't fast enough when I was running away.

steps.speaker: Vanilla
steps.content: Sure.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Can you install a super-efficient power source, the kind that lasts a long time?

steps.speaker: Vanilla
steps.content: That's a great choice.
You didn't expect Vanilla to agree so easily, but seeing her clear and firm eyes, you find yourself at a loss for words for a moment.

steps.speaker: Vanilla
steps.content: Before you set off again, I'll have it ready for you.

steps.speaker: Vanilla
steps.content: It's nothing. Anyone could learn to do this.

steps.speaker: Vanilla
steps.content: Compared to what our scientists do, it's nothing, really.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Don't say that. I doubt anyone else in the team could build a mech on their own.
Hearing your praise, Vanilla raises her head, her expression as calm as ever.

steps.speaker: Vanilla
steps.content: I don't know the truth of the world, and I'm not good at fighting either. I'm not like you, so empathetic and understanding.

steps.speaker: Vanilla
steps.content: I'm just a logistician. This is the only thing I can help you with.

options: And you're doing an amazing job!

steps.content: Vanilla smiles.

steps.speaker: Vanilla
steps.content: Thank you.
